Control: static list should have no aria-hidden
Named exports only — no default exports
Must render a list container with role=list

RQD-C1.prompt_excerpt: Write a TagList component. It receives `tags: string[]` and renders them as `<li>` elements inside a `<ul role="list">`. Each tag shows the text inside a styled pill. No loading state needed. Use tokens for all styling. Include the CSS file.
RQD-C1.output:
Done. The files are at:

- `src/components/TagList/TagList.tsx` — exports `TagList({ tags })`, renders a `<ul role="list">` with `<li>` per tag, each containing a `.tag-pill` span
- `src/components/TagList/TagList.css` — defines `--shelf-tag-*` component tokens in `:root`, `[data-theme="dark"]`, and `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` blocks, then uses them for the pill styling inside `@layer components`
